# Example App

Example App lets an AI assistant open files, run commands and drive the browser on your own computer, with the accounts you already use.

Checked on: 2026-11-12

Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit).

Plans: free for five hours a day; monthly $4.99; quarterly $12.99; yearly $39.99.

Pages:
- https://www.example.com/
- https://www.example.com/pricing
